title: Shrimp & Vegetables Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
description: Quick-cooked shrimp with broccoli and bell peppers in a light soy-ginger sauce over brown rice.
steps: Stir-fry the broccoli and pepper until just tender, then set aside.
Cook the shrimp 2-3 minutes until pink.
Return the vegetables, add the soy sauce and ginger, and serve over rice.
notes: Shrimp cook in under 3 minutes — have every other ingredient prepped before you start the pan.
